title: Is Artificial Intelligence Helping or Hurting the Climate?
subtitle: New research suggests that AI technology is currently doing more to increase fossil fuel production than it is to help clean energy.

summary.en: A new study reveals that AI is helping companies find and produce more oil, gas, and coal. While AI can help renewable energy, its current impact on fossil fuels is much larger. Experts warn that these productivity gains are leading to higher carbon emissions. Major energy companies are already using AI to discover new oil wells and save money. The research suggests that without major changes, AI will continue to make climate change worse.
summary.zh: 一項最新研究揭露，人工智慧正在協助企業探勘並生產更多的石油、天然氣與煤炭。儘管人工智慧能協助再生能源發展，但其目前對化石燃料的影響力要大得多。專家警告，這些生產力的提升正導致碳排放量增加。大型能源公司已開始利用人工智慧來發現新油井並節省成本。研究指出，若無重大改變，人工智慧將持續惡化氣候變遷問題。

paragraphs.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing almost every part of our lives, from how we work to how we use energy. For a long time, many people hoped that AI would be a powerful tool to fight climate change. They believed it could help manage electricity grids better and make renewable energy, like wind and solar power, more efficient. However, a new study suggests that AI might actually be doing more harm than good for the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧（AI）正在改變我們生活的幾乎每一個層面，從我們的工作方式到能源的使用皆然。長期以來，許多人寄望人工智慧能成為對抗氣候變遷的強大工具。他們相信人工智慧有助於更妥善地管理電力網，並提升風能與太陽能等再生能源的效率。然而，一項最新研究指出，人工智慧對環境造成的危害可能大於其帶來的益處。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, researchers have found that AI is currently helping the fossil fuel industry more than it is helping clean energy. The study looked at 64 different scenarios to see how AI affects the energy sector. It found that, on average, AI-driven productivity—the ability to produce more goods or services in less time—leads to an increase in carbon pollution. This pollution comes from the extra oil, gas, and coal that companies are now able to find and extract using new technology.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，研究人員發現，人工智慧目前對化石燃料產業的助益，遠大於對潔淨能源的幫助。該研究檢視了 64 種不同情境，以觀察人工智慧如何影響能源部門。研究發現，平均而言，由人工智慧驅動的生產力提升——即在更短時間內生產更多商品或服務的能力——導致了碳污染的增加。這些污染源自於企業利用新技術所能額外探勘與開採出的石油、天然氣及煤炭。

paragraphs.en: In the past, many studies only looked at how much energy AI datacentres use. They often ignored the fact that AI is also being used to make drilling for oil cheaper and faster. Lynn Kaack, an expert in computer science and public policy, noted that previous research often missed this bigger picture. She explained that many studies focused on the energy needed to run AI systems but ignored the extra emissions caused by using AI to increase fossil fuel production.
paragraphs.zh: 過去，許多研究僅關注人工智慧資料中心消耗了多少能源，卻往往忽略了人工智慧也被用於降低石油鑽探成本並提升其速度的事實。電腦科學與公共政策專家琳恩·卡克（Lynn Kaack）指出，先前的研究往往忽略了這個大局。她解釋說，許多研究聚焦於運行人工智慧系統所需的能源，卻忽視了利用人工智慧增加化石燃料生產所產生的額外排放。

paragraphs.en: Why is this happening? The answer lies in how quickly the industry is adopting this technology. Holly Alpine, a co-author of the study, explained that fossil fuel companies are already using AI at a large scale. They have real contracts and are using the technology in their daily work right now. In contrast, many AI applications for renewable energy are still in the early testing phase. These clean energy projects often face other problems, such as difficulty getting legal permission to build or connecting to the power grid.
paragraphs.zh: 為什麼會發生這種情況？答案在於產業採用這項技術的速度。該研究的共同作者荷莉·阿爾派恩（Holly Alpine）解釋道，化石燃料公司早已大規模使用人工智慧。他們擁有實際合約，且目前正將這項技術應用於日常工作中。相較之下，許多針對再生能源的人工智慧應用仍處於早期測試階段。這些潔淨能源專案往往面臨其他問題，例如難以取得建設的法律許可，或是難以併入電力網。

paragraphs.en: Energy companies are very open about their success with AI. The International Energy Agency estimates that AI could increase the amount of oil and gas that companies can recover by 5%. It could also cut the cost of deepwater offshore projects by 10%. Some oil and gas executives are even calling this new wave of technology "the next fracking boom," referring to a method of drilling that significantly increased oil and gas production in the past.
paragraphs.zh: 能源公司對於他們在人工智慧領域的成功毫不避諱。國際能源總署（International Energy Agency）估計，人工智慧可使企業能回收的石油與天然氣量增加 5%，並能將深海離岸專案的成本降低 10%。一些石油與天然氣公司的高層甚至將這波新技術浪潮稱為「下一個水力壓裂熱潮」，意指過去曾大幅提升石油與天然氣產量的一種鑽探方法。

paragraphs.en: Specific examples show how this works in the real world. Saudi Aramco, a major energy company, stated last year that it has used AI in almost every part of its business to increase the number of wells it operates. Similarly, the company Equinor recently credited AI and new seismic technology for 27 new discoveries on the Norwegian continental shelf. One of these, the Lofn and Langermann oil wells, was described by the company as its largest discovery in 2025. Equinor said that AI was key to this success, helping them plan their wells and understand data more efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 具體案例顯示了這項技術在現實世界中的運作方式。大型能源公司沙烏地阿拉伯國家石油公司（Saudi Aramco）去年表示，已將人工智慧應用於其業務的幾乎每一個環節，以增加其營運的油井數量。同樣地，挪威國家能源公司（Equinor）近期將其在挪威大陸棚的 27 項新發現，歸功於人工智慧與新的地震探勘技術。其中，Lofn 與 Langermann 油井被該公司形容為 2025 年最大的發現。Equinor 表示，人工智慧是達成此成就的關鍵，協助他們更有效率地規劃油井並解讀數據。

paragraphs.en: Financial experts are also seeing the impact of these changes. Rystad Energy, an independent research company, estimated that AI and digital tools would create nearly $500 billion in value for fossil fuel companies between 2026 and 2030. This value comes from faster production, more efficient operations, and shorter timelines for building new projects. Analysts at Rystad Energy noted that these returns are already visible, pointing to large savings reported by companies like Equinor and Abu Dhabi’s Adnoc.
paragraphs.zh: 金融專家也觀察到了這些變化的影響。獨立研究公司 Rystad Energy 估計，在 2026 年至 2030 年間，人工智慧與數位工具將為化石燃料公司創造近 5,000 億美元的價值。這些價值來自於更快的生產速度、更有效率的營運，以及縮短新專案的建設時程。Rystad Energy 的分析師指出，這些回報已經顯現，並舉出 Equinor 與阿布達比國家石油公司（Adnoc）等企業所報告的巨大節省金額為例。

paragraphs.en: The study concludes that for AI to actually help the climate, the situation would need to change drastically. If both clean and dirty energy facilities continue to use AI at the same speed, the gains for renewable energy would need to be at least four times greater than the gains for fossil fuels just to keep emissions from rising. Right now, that is not happening. As AI continues to advance, the challenge for policymakers and climate scientists will be to ensure that this technology is used to protect the planet rather than to speed up the extraction of fuels that cause global warming.
paragraphs.zh: 該研究總結認為，若要讓人工智慧真正有助於氣候，現況必須發生劇烈改變。如果潔淨能源與高污染能源設施繼續以相同的速度使用人工智慧，那麼再生能源所獲得的效益必須至少是化石燃料效益的四倍，才能防止排放量持續上升。目前，這種情況並未發生。隨著人工智慧持續進步，決策者與氣候科學家將面臨挑戰，必須確保這項技術是用於保護地球，而非加速開採那些導致全球暖化的燃料。

sources.title: AI’s potential climate benefits outweighed by role in boosting fossil fuels, study finds

quiz.question: According to the study, why does AI-driven productivity currently lead to an increase in carbon pollution?

options.A: Because AI datacentres require massive amounts of electricity to function.
options.B: Because companies use AI to locate and extract more oil, gas, and coal.
options.C: Because renewable energy projects are failing to connect to the power grid.
options.D: Because the fossil fuel industry is investing $500 billion into new green technology.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，AI 驅動的生產力提升導致碳排放增加，是因為企業利用這項技術更有效地尋找並開採石油、天然氣與煤炭。選項 A 雖然提到資料中心耗能，但文中提到這是過去研究的焦點，而非本研究強調的碳排放主因。選項 C 是再生能源面臨的挑戰，而非 AI 導致污染的原因。選項 D 數字錯誤，且該金額是預估化石燃料公司獲得的價值，而非綠能投資。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the current adoption of AI in the energy sector?

options.A: Fossil fuel companies are struggling to implement AI due to legal restrictions.
options.B: Renewable energy companies are intentionally avoiding AI to protect the environment.
options.C: The fossil fuel industry has a competitive advantage in AI deployment over the renewable sector.
options.D: AI technology is currently equally beneficial to both fossil fuel and renewable energy production.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，化石燃料公司已大規模應用 AI，且有實際合約，而再生能源的應用仍處於早期測試階段，且面臨法規與電網連接等困難。這顯示化石燃料業在 AI 部署上領先。選項 A 與文中敘述相反，化石燃料業正積極使用 AI。選項 B 錯誤，再生能源並非不想用，而是受限於測試階段與基礎設施問題。選項 D 錯誤，文中明確指出 AI 目前對化石燃料的助益遠大於對綠能的幫助。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'credited' mean in the context of the sentence: 'Equinor recently credited AI and new seismic technology for 27 new discoveries'?

options.A: Acknowledged as the source or cause of something.
options.B: Added a financial amount to an account.
options.C: Praised someone for their hard work.
options.D: Believed something to be true despite a lack of evidence.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此句中，Equinor 將 27 項新發現歸功於 AI 與地震技術，意指這些技術是達成該成果的主要原因或來源。選項 B 是金融術語，指存入款項，不符語境。選項 C 雖有「稱讚」之意，但此處重點在於因果關係的歸屬，而非單純的讚美。選項 D 錯誤，Equinor 是基於實際的探勘成功案例，而非單純的相信。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding AI and the environment?

options.A: AI will eventually solve climate change if we increase funding for datacentres.
options.B: Fossil fuel companies are the only ones capable of using AI effectively.
options.C: AI is a neutral tool that has no significant impact on global carbon emissions.
options.D: AI is currently accelerating fossil fuel extraction, undermining its potential to help the climate.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章總結了 AI 目前的發展趨勢：儘管人們曾寄望 AI 能對抗氣候變遷，但現況是它被大量用於加速化石燃料的開採，導致環境損害大於助益。選項 A 與文章結論相悖。選項 B 過於武斷，文中並未說其他產業無法使用。選項 C 錯誤，文中強調 AI 對碳排放有顯著的負面影響。因此 D 最能概括全文對於 AI 雙面刃性質的擔憂。
